distribution: AQ derived source; not an upstream release

reference_sources.scope: ID8 RHMI generator, cells and renderer application area
Public SDK lifecycle, entry point and typed read-only field/member contract

changes: Separate ID7 and ID8 RHMI resource trees with preserved state IDs and ID7 output
ID8 platform declarations, text cell mapping and native settings rows
Native renderer requirement, application area placement and touch settings
Foreground and background lifecycle, bounded entry initialization and visibility handling
MainApp family path selection: oap-mainapp for ID7 and oap-mainapp21 for ID8
Original and donor notices embedded in the derived target package
Car Care ID8 read-only odometer adapter, invalid/stale/provider-loss guard for locally recorded mileage, and stopped-reader cleanup
Car Lyrics ID8 read-only media adapter, per-instance and per-field freshness, provider-loss display, source selection and stopped-reader cleanup
Fullscreen touch bounds use the renderer-reported ID8 application area and its local coordinates; the original ID7 branch is retained
Widget applications use explicit --target-hmi or exactly one installed MainApp family; unknown/ambiguous hosts fail before packaging
ID7 widget payload is preserved; ID8 target packages omit unsupported widgets and show the limitation in Settings and package metadata
limits: No OEM SDK is included or executed by offline tests
No actual target build, HU registration or live ID8 run has been observed
ID8 canvas requires mgu-render >= 0.6.24 with native rendering, touch routing and a usable application area
Unknown or ambiguous MainApp paths are reported; host builds of widget applications require --target-hmi ID7 or ID8
Car Care and Car Lyrics have no ID8 home-screen widget; their ID7 target packages retain the original widget
The read-only typed backend needs compatible target SDK members/providers; missing members are reported, never replaced with invented values
Car Care requires a valid fresh odometer to record mileage; cached values remain labelled last seen
Car Lyrics needs the original internet/uplink path for its lyrics and artwork; these external services were not called in offline tests
Other Aref applications and Tire Setup actions are not ported by this package

target_build_contract.selection: --target-hmi ID7|ID8; otherwise exactly one directory /usr/lib/oap-mainapp or /usr/lib/oap-mainapp21

version_policy: AQ patch versions distinguish changed packages from the unchanged upstream releases; the Store compares x.y.z, not the AQ revision label.
